messages:
olivia: Heads-up from customer onboarding: after switching to Docker Swarm for the sampleapp, we saw a wave of duplicate invoice callbacks during a scale test. Looks like retries across many replicas lined up.
dan: any snippets or repro steps?
olivia: minimal repro: deploy 12 replicas with swarm rolling update and run the load generator. Logs show many retries with identical jitter and no idempotency header. Snip: 
```
2026-04-02T09:12:10.100Z WARN retry: got 429 attempt=1 backoff_ms=0.0 req=inv_210
2026-04-02T09:12:10.100Z DEBUG retry: jitter_ms=5 seed=42 replica=3
2026-04-02T09:12:10.100Z INFO sender: POST /callbacks inv_210 idempotency=absent
```
mika: seed=42? where's that coming from?
sai: looks like the retry lib seeds from the docker container hostname hash which for a Swarm overlay net might be deterministic across replicas in our env (hash collision + small modulus).
dan: ouch. combined with our sampleapp defaulting to safe_replay=false for "simplicity" in quickstart, that's an accidental time bomb.
mika: proposed fixes: 1) change seeding to use crypto-random per-process; 2) make SafeReplay (Idempotency-Key) enabled by default in sampleapp and quickstart templates; 3) when deterministic flags are requested (for single-dev use), require an explicit --single-process flag and emit a warning if run in clustered mode; 4) introduce a tiny jitter floor (2-6ms) unless user passes --zero-jitter-explicit.
olivia: +1. also add a healthcheck/backoff integration note: when orchestrators restart many replicas at once, startup timings can correlate and amplify thundering-herd. docs should warn.
sai: implementation note: we'll generate Idempotency-Key automatically if missing using a deterministic per-request hash of (request_id + instance_uuid) so it won't collide across retries but preserves user-supplied keys.
dan: test plan: nightly CI job that spins up a 10-replica swarm (or simulated) and runs thundering-herd sim to catch false negatives. add a canary to staging that runs after deploy.
deploy-bot: created PR 4510 on branch fix/swarm-seed-idempotency by sai. CI queued.
ops-bot: ticket INF-3011 created: "Swarm/Orchestrator-correlated RNG seed -> duplicate callbacks" assigned to @mika.
olm: (minor) can we log the seed and replica id at startup for easier triage?
mika: yes, but ensure we redact sensitive parts in customer logs.
olivia: actionable items:@sai - PR to reseed with crypto and auto-idempotency; @mika - update quickstart & docs to enable SafeReplay by default + warning text; @dan - add swarm nightly test harness. Anyone object?
dan: no objections, will prioritize after standup.
mika: thanks. leaving a short note for support: "If you run sampleapp on an orchestrator and see duplicated side-effects, set SAFE_REPLAY=1 and restart replicas one-by-one instead of rolling all at once." :warning:
